<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def gcells(fr):
    N=[(r,c) for r,l in enumerate(fr.ascii.split('\n')) for c,ch in enumerate(l) if ch=='N']
    return sorted({(r//6,c//6) for (r,c) in N})
def pcol(fr):
    for r,l in enumerate(fr.ascii.split('\n')):
        if 'Y' in l: return r,l.index('Y')
log=[]
for i in range(20):
    cells=gcells(current_frame)
    if not cells:
        log.append("cleared all"); break
    gr,gc=cells[0]
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':gr*6+3,'col':gc*6+3}],intent='explore')
    lc=res.get('level_completed') if isinstance(res,dict) else None
    ni=res.get('no_impact') if isinstance(res,dict) else None
    log.append(f"click({gr},{gc}) -> {len(gcells(current_frame))} left, lc={lc}, ni={ni}")
    if lc or ni: break
print("player",pcol(current_frame))
print("\n".join(log))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
